summary: Comprehensive manual test checklist for GhostNet core flows. Covers 8 sequential phases: Sign Up (email + password + verification code), Create Identity (BIP39 seed + Ed25519 keypair), Set PIN (PBKDF2 @ 600K iterations), Send Message (AES-256-GCM + HMAC-SHA256 E2E encryption), Receive Message (WebSocket real-time delivery + decryption), Enable Ghost Mode (3-tier Shield: Stealth/Ghost/Phantom), Logout (tokenVersion bump + session/storage cleanup), and Recover with Seed Phrase (identity restoration + key regeneration). Includes 68 individual test steps with expected results, notes columns, preconditions, edge cases, negative tests, and a summary scorecard. Built from direct analysis of the GhostNet codebase.
